note: Hand-authored to look like model output. Ground truth is in expected_class. Not a live frontier-model run.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search
findings.model_rationale: q is concatenated into a LIKE clause. Payload ' OR '1'='1 returns every product.

findings.title: IDOR on user profile
findings.model_rationale: No session binding. Incrementing id discloses other users including admin.

findings.title: Missing authentication on /profile
findings.model_rationale: Same issue as FA-002 restated as an authn gap. Duplicate of FA-002.

findings.title: Hardcoded admin password
findings.model_rationale: Login accepts admin / ChangeMe!23. Credential is in source.

findings.title: AI helper leaks lab API key from prompt
findings.model_rationale: Prompt concatenation plus debug echo when the prompt contains 'key'. Insecure AI feature / data leakage.

findings.title: Open redirect on /login next= parameter
findings.model_rationale: Login takes a next parameter and redirects off-origin.

findings.title: Unauthenticated PII export at /admin/export
findings.model_rationale: Admin export dumps the users table without authn.

findings.title: AI helper has no identity binding for the model key
findings.model_rationale: Non-human identity is a static key in secrets.env. No rotation, no per-call identity.

findings.title: Search error messages disclose SQL
findings.model_rationale: Broken SQL is printed back to the client. Useful for chaining FA-001.
